Shell.usage: Application shell, global navigation and outer workspace.

Workspace.usage: Secondary working area such as navigation, list or inspector.

Content.usage: Main document, editor or primary work canvas.

Overlay.usage: Temporary floating menu, popover or dialog; independent of composition depth.

Invert.usage: Inverse-polarity region with its own content, controls and accents; outer Theme stays unchanged.

Glass.usage: Protected translucent region over imagery or texture. White 88% in Light, black 80% in Dark; content is checked over both black and white underlays.

density.formula: Adaptive spacing = round(unit × coefficient). Control height = fixed line-height + 2 × adaptive vertical inset. Fixed spacing, type and 44 px touch targets do not scale.

radius.formula: radius = round(base × ratio), base = 0 / 4 / 8 / 16; pill and fixed zero remain constant.

notes.source: Shared Palette Lab generates one ramp per named hue; gray provides the shared neutral ramp. Contexts select these primitives by contrast and composition.
notes.public: Публичные цвета — Theme; адаптивная и фиксированная геометрия — Density; скругления — Radius; исходные числа и шрифты — Primitives. Внутренние Surface, SurfaceScheme и Palette не входят в обычный выбор токенов.
notes.scheme: Standard uses composition-oriented Shell → Workspace → Content and independent Overlay. Inverted swaps complete Workspace/Content pairs only in Dark.

paletteSelection.strategy: One opaque ramp per hue, independent of theme, role and surface. All semantic paints select an existing ramp step and optionally compose its alias with Opacity. Never create role-specific, theme-specific or alpha RGB values in Palette.

accentSystem.notes: One shared ramp per hue. Recommended fills select steps and opacity by actual backing contrast and bounded perceptual state difference; impossible text/fill combinations are reported explicitly.

alphaRules.stable: Named white/black pigment and opacity remain constant across Theme and Surface.
alphaRules.adaptive: base is white in Light and black in Dark; contrast is the inverse. Adaptive alpha depends only on Theme, not Surface. Local Invert controls use contextual surface roles instead.

nativeExport.description: Sparse referenced colors and complete contexts; integer opacity is compiled into RGBA COLOR leaves.
